title: TCM-DiagCommit: A TCM-SD-Derived Benchmark for Evidence-Conditioned Syndrome Selection and Commitment
abstract: arXiv:2610.37243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) syndrome differentiation is usually evaluated as static final-label selection over complete clinical records. This setting hides three diagnostic behaviors: whether a model distinguishes semantic-neighbor syndrome labels from easy random distractors, whether it updates predictions as evidence fields are revealed, and whether it should commit under uncertainty. We introduce TCM-DiagCommit, a benchmark derived from the public TCM-SD/ZY-BERT resource while retaining its source syndrome labels; it converts 1,834 source cases into 23,842 task rows over 148 syndrome labels. The benchmark combines random, profile-neighbor, and full-vocabulary candidate ladders with staged t1/t2/t3 evidence. It also includes fixed-label tongue/pulse perturbations and insufficient-evidence variants. A benchmark-defined action contract scores commit, acquire, defer, and abstain. translated_title: TCM-DiagCommit：一个源自TCM-SD的证据条件化证型选择与承诺决策基准
translated_abstract: 中医（TCM）证型辨析通常被评估为在完整临床记录上的静态最终标签选择任务。这种设置掩盖了三种关键诊断行为：模型能否区分语义邻近的证型标签与简单的随机干扰项；模型能否随着证据字段的逐步揭示而更新预测；以及模型在不确定情况下是否应当做出诊断承诺。我们提出了TCM-DiagCommit，这是一个基于公开TCM-SD/ZY-BERT资源构建的基准，同时保留了其原始证型标签；该基准将1,834个原始病例转换为覆盖148个证型标签的23,842个任务条目。该基准将随机、档案邻近和全词表三级候选阶梯与分阶段的t1/t2/t3证据相结合，还包含固定标签的舌诊/脉诊扰动样本和证据不足变体。基准定义的动作契约对“承诺”、“获取更多证据”、“延迟决策”和“弃权”四种动作进行评分。在五次零样本DirectLLM校准中，随机……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TCM-DiagCommit基准，将中医证型辨析从静态最终标签选择扩展为证据条件化的动态评估框架，通过分阶段证据揭示、语义邻近候选干扰及承诺/获取/延迟/弃权的动作契约，系统考察大模型在中医诊断中的渐进推理与不确定性决策能力。
en_tdlr: TCM-DiagCommit, derived from the TCM-SD resource, transforms TCM syndrome differentiation from static final-label selection into an evidence-conditioned benchmark that tests models' ability to distinguish semantic-neighbor syndromes, update predictions with staged evidence, and make commit/defer/abstain decisions under uncertainty.
